product.detailed_description: M&S Collection Colombian Coffee Beans This well-balanced coffee is grown in the foothills of the Andes, resulting in a smooth cup to be enjoyed at any time of the day. Enjoy a rewarding, sweet flavour with notes of caramel and hints of blackcurrant. No 4 rich roast. 100% arabica. Welcome to Collection from M&S, where exceptional quality and intricate attention to detail makes for something truly special. Fairtrade works with farmers and workers so they can earn better prices, invest in their communities and businesses, enhance their livelihoods and protect our shared environment. We contribute more Fairtrade Premium for tea and coffee than any other UK retailer, so farmers can invest more in their future.
product.further_description: Expertly grown within our Fairtrade Partnership Fairtrade works with farmers & workers so they can earn better prices, invest in their communities & businesses, enhance their livelihoods & protect our shared environment. Paying a fairer price Fairtrade Premium We contribute more Fairtrade premium for tea & coffee than any other UK retailer, so farmers can invest more in their future. Coffee is Fairtrade certified, traded, audited and sourced from Fairtrade producers, Total 100%. Visit info.fairtrade.net/sourcing
product.brand_marketing: M&S Food has been at the heart of the nation since 1884. Giving our customers their best-loved products at the incredible quality and value that only M&S can deliver. From Percy Pig to the freshest M&S Select Farms produce, we grow, source, and develop our own products to give you family-ready food that's unbeatable on flavour and innovation. And that's whether you come to us for your family favourites, an indulgent treat, or your perfect party food spread. After all, this is not just food… This is M&S Food.
product.other_information: Full Product Name: Roasted arabica coffee beans Storage: Once opened, store in an airtight container for 2 weeks in the refrigerator, or 4 weeks in the freezer. Additional Information: Packaged in a protective atmosphere for freshness. © Marks and Spencer plc
product.preparation_and_usage: Serving For the perfect cafetière: 1. Use one heaped tablespoon of coffee per person. 2. Pour over 200ml of freshly boiled water per person. 3. Stir, wait 3-5 minutes, and plunge. Adjust according to taste.
